title: 5-Day Siem Reap Luxury Boutique Golf & Spa Retreat
description: Eco-luxury riverside living at Jaya House River Park. Play Angkor Golf Resort and Phokeethra with daily spa treatments.

signatureTour.title: The Khmer Temple Trail
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive 7-day tour combining boutique riverside luxury with extended temple scholar journeys.

inclusions.detail: Chauffeured private transport for all airport and golf course trips.
3 rounds: 2 rounds at Angkor Golf Resort and 1 round at Phokeethra Country Club.
4 nights in a Deluxe River View Room at Jaya House River Park.
Inclusive daily 60-minute therapeutic massage at Jaya Spa.

itinerary.title: Arrival along the Siem Reap River & River Villa Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Eco-Luxury Welcome
itinerary.imageCaption: Jaya House River Park — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Jaya House River Park luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Siem Reap and meet your private chauffeur for transfer to Jaya House River Park, renowned for its outstanding hospitality, hanging gardens, and silver-tiled swimming pool along the river.

Unpack in your riverfront room before an evening stroll along the quiet riverbanks and an authentic Khmer dinner at Trorkuon restaurant.

itinerary.title: Strategic Precision at Sir Nick Faldo’s Angkor Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Faldo Championship Design
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Angkor Golf Resort. Faldo's bunkering and contoured greens demand strategic club selection and sharp approach play.

Return to Jaya House for an inclusive 60-minute deep-tissue massage at the spa, decompressing your swing muscles.

itinerary.title: Historic Parkland at Phokeethra Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Sofitel Managed Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Phokeethra Country Club — Weerayudth Phetbuasak (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Phokeethra Country Club championship golf course Weerayudth Phetbuasak Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Phokeethra Country Club, enjoying tree-lined fairways, scenic water carries, and the signature 11th-century stone bridge.

Spend the evening exploring Siem Reap’s craft markets and vibrant dining quarter.

itinerary.title: Mastering the Contours: Angkor Golf Resort Replay Round
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Replay
itinerary.imageCaption: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Angkor Golf Resort Siem Reap championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Return to Angkor Golf Resort for a second round, utilizing your course knowledge to take on Faldo's bold greens with greater confidence.

Celebrate with a farewell riverside barbecue dinner at Jaya House under the ancient trees.

itinerary.title: Morning River Tranquility & Airport Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Jaya House River Park — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Jaya House River Park luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an unhurried breakfast beside the silver pool before checking out.

Your private executive transfer transports your party to Siem Reap Airport for your onward flight.

faqs.question: Is Jaya House River Park eco-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jaya House is 100% single-use plastic free and actively leads tree-planting initiatives throughout Siem Reap.
